Description

The River Caves are between Ferwater and Finlay. They are characterized by its thick fog. Along with the other River biomes, it is accessible via explodable walls right after the curved bridge leading to another section of Finlay Island or also accessible via big waterfall to the right of the Bridge that leads to Ferwater Island.

There is a Lab , a River Shop and a possible Pirate Boat spawn.

Resources

  • Prismarine nodes , found on land.
  • Blue Clay, Red Clay, Brown Clay nodes , found in water.
  • Lumite nodes , found in prismarine.
  • Plek , found in a smaller seperate cave in an underwater section , near the River Shop
  • In one of the fishing sneak peeks on Discord, Hoofer displayed a fish being caught with the name Stone fish. It had a stone texture.
